title: License a private hospital
what: Hold a licence before conducting or managing a private hospital.

laws.title: Private Hospitals and Health Services Act 1927 (WA)

sources.title: Private Hospitals and Health Services Act 1927 (WA)
sources.quote: A person must not — (a) conduct or manage, or by any means hold out that the person conducts or manages, a private hospital unless — (i) the person is the holder of a licence;
